rule: Select the earliest boundary whose exact parent-driven physical output, restart packet, covariance, and independent reconstruction are absent. Do not infer execution from formal law or representative verification.

rows.known_strength: Strong formal triad/kernel/N-body architecture exists in prior work.
rows.unverified_requirement: Exact admitted source bytes, final typed prephysical packet, independent reconstruction, and verified freeze in 3-RFC.

rows.known_strength: A mathematically explicit Big Implosion operator and representative verification exist in prior lineages.
rows.unverified_requirement: One exact physically executed first-state packet from the admitted A parent, with restart, covariance, no-loss reopening, and independent replay.

rows.known_strength: Microscopic constitution laws/interfaces have been formalized in prior work.
rows.unverified_requirement: Exact parent-driven field/particle/interaction/mass/mixing state rather than representative examples.

rows.known_strength: Early-universe law architecture and representative checks exist.
rows.unverified_requirement: Cumulative physical trajectory with exact parent packets, solver state, covariance, restart, and independent replay.

rows.known_strength: Transfer, background, and covariance architecture is well developed.
rows.unverified_requirement: Actual realized background, immutable instantiation, primordial covariance, and finite-volume field packet consumed by K.

rows.known_strength: Repaired first-pass hydro/MHD/radiation/thermochemistry/star-formation architecture independently passed at its declared scope.
rows.unverified_requirement: Execution from exact physical K parent and participation in physical K-L-M recurrence.

rows.known_strength: Law architecture and reduced F0 recurrence exist.
rows.unverified_requirement: Physical isotope/chemical state and F1-F4 coupled recurrence; F0 cannot be promoted.
